description: Codex, design review of the Python versions (round 1): Python 3.15's lazy import (PEP 810). Python compiles the file, but tree-sitter-python (0.25.0, the newest release) has no `lazy` keyword: the file has syntax errors for the tree that finds the forms, so its tests may be hidden or invented and the comparison is UNVERIFIABLE — never OK, never a FAIL (docs/rules.md, *Known limits of attribution*; backlog). The real runner skips the test.
